name: Hacker News (Show HN)
price_notes: Free. No paid placement.
review_process: Community ranking. Posts can be flagged. There is no editorial SLA.
submission_rules: Prefix the title with 'Show HN:'. Share something you made, be ready to answer technical questions, and avoid marketing-speak. Read the official Show HN guidelines before posting. New accounts may have submission limits.
notes: High-signal technical audience. A good post can spike traffic; a promotional post is often poorly received.
source: Official Hacker News Show HN guidelines

name: Indie Hackers
price_notes: Product pages and community posts are free; Indie Hackers+ is an optional membership and is not required to list a product.
review_process: Community posts and product pages; milestone and launch posts are subject to community guidelines.
submission_rules: Create an account, add a product page, and participate in the community. Self-promotion is expected to be substantive (build logs, revenue stories, help requests), not drive-by spam.
notes: Strong for bootstrapped and creator-led products; conversation quality matters more than a single launch day.

name: AlternativeTo
price_notes: Suggesting a new application is free with an account. There is no standard paid featured-product requirement for a basic listing.
review_process: Community suggestions are reviewed before they appear.
submission_rules: Sign in and suggest a new application. List clear alternatives so people can find you from competitor pages. AI tools are commonly listed.
notes: Discovery often comes from alternatives-to-X pages rather than a homepage launch. Homepage check returned blocked (HTTP 403 bot-protection / challenge page); this build did not treat the page as successfully opened.

name: G2
price_notes: Basic product profiles are typically free to create or claim. Paid marketing, featured placement, and buyer-intent products are commercial add-ons with custom pricing.
review_process: Vendor profile plus user reviews. Reviews are moderated. Category visibility usually depends on review volume, not just creating a profile.
submission_rules: Create or claim a product profile. AI and B2B software are widely listed. Do not fabricate reviews; G2 has anti-fraud rules.
notes: One of the main software review destinations buyers use. A profile without reviews has limited category presence.
